sources.notes: Agent inferred that a video/world-model Diffusion Transformer review needs both the generic DiT-video lineage (Sora/Stable Video Diffusion/Genie/Veo/HunyuanVideo/CogVideoX/Open-Sora) and the limitation/evaluation/action-conditioned world-model surfaces that static embodied taxonomy does not cover.

queries.label: dit-video-core
queries.query: all:"diffusion transformer" AND (all:"video generation" OR all:"video synthesis")
queries.why: Direct vocabulary for Diffusion Transformer applied to video generation.

queries.label: dit-world-model-core
queries.query: all:"diffusion transformer" AND all:"world model"
queries.why: Diffusion Transformer used as a world model / video-world-model.

queries.label: video-latent-diffusion-core
queries.query: all:"latent diffusion" AND (all:"video generation" OR all:"video world model")
queries.why: Latent video diffusion architecture that underlies DiT-video models.

queries.label: sora-lineage
queries.query: all:"Sora" AND (all:"diffusion" OR all:"world model" OR all:"video")
queries.why: Sora demonstrated DiT on video and is a pivotal anchor even without public tech report completeness.

queries.label: stv-lineage
queries.query: all:"Stable Video Diffusion"
queries.why: Stable Video Diffusion is a canonical video diffusion method and its successors (SVD-XT, Mochi, LongMoE) form a lineage.

queries.label: genie-lineage
queries.query: all:"Genie" AND (all:"world model" OR all:"interactive")
queries.why: Genie / Genie 2 are action-conditioned video world models built on video generation.

queries.label: hunyuan-cogvideo-opensora
queries.query: all:"HunyuanVideo" OR all:"CogVideoX" OR all:"Open-Sora"
queries.why: Modern open DiT video models that report architecture, scaling, and evaluation details.

queries.label: veo-moviegen-kling-wan
queries.query: all:"Veo" OR all:"MovieGen" OR all:"Kling" OR all:"Wan"
queries.why: Nearer-term flagship video world-model/generation systems frequently benchmarked against.

queries.label: dit-scaling-mechanism
queries.query: all:"scaling" AND (all:"diffusion transformer" OR all:"diffusion" AND all:"video")
queries.why: Scaling-law evidence for diffusion transformers in video/world-model context.

queries.label: rectified-flow-mechanism
queries.query: all:"flow matching" OR all:"rectified flow"
queries.why: Flow matching / rectified flow is the training objective behind most current DiT-video and Sora-style models and shapes quality.

queries.label: video-vae-mechanism
queries.query: all:"video autoencoder" OR all:"spatiotemporal VAE" OR all:"3D VAE"
queries.why: Latent video compression/representation (3D VAE) is a core component on which DiT-video quality depends.

queries.label: spatiotemporal-attention-mechanism
queries.query: all:"spatiotemporal attention" AND (all:"video" OR all:"diffusion")
queries.why: Temporal/space-time attention design inside video DiT.

queries.label: autoregressive-diffusion-hybrid-mechanism
queries.query: all:"autoregressive" AND all:"diffusion" AND (all:"video" OR all:"token")
queries.why: Hybrid autoregressive+diffusion pipelines (e.g. W.A.L.T, next-token video models) competing with pure DiT.

queries.label: physics-consistency-limitation
queries.query: all:"physics" AND all:"video generation" AND (all:"inconsistent" OR all:"violation" OR all:"dynamics")
queries.why: Core limitation: generated video lacks physical consistency/real dynamics.

queries.label: temporal-consistency-limitation
queries.query: all:"temporal consistency" AND (all:"video generation" OR all:"world model" OR all:"diffusion")
queries.why: Limitation: temporal coherence and long-term consistency of generated video.

queries.label: object-entity-persistence-limitation
queries.query: all:"entity" AND all:"persistence" AND all:"video"
queries.why: Limitation: object identity persistence and multimodal interaction in generated scenes.

queries.label: action-conditioned-worldmodel-eval
queries.query: all:"action-conditioned" AND (all:"world model" OR all:"video prediction" OR all:"planning")
queries.why: Evaluation surface: whether DiT-video world models are truly action-controllable and usable for planning.

queries.label: video-world-model-review-eval
queries.query: all:"video world model" AND (all:"benchmark" OR all:"evaluation" OR all:"survey")
queries.why: Evaluation: benchmarks and surveys for video world models.

queries.label: video-reward-model-eval
queries.query: all:"video reward model" OR all:"video quality assessment"
queries.why: Evaluation: reward/quality models for generated video, a practical gate.

queries.label: long-horizon-consistency-eval
queries.query: all:"long-horizon" AND (all:"video" OR all:"world model" OR all:"consistency")
queries.why: Evaluation: long-horizon rollouts and consistency in video world models.

queries.label: inference-cost-deployment
queries.query: all:"diffusion" AND all:"video" AND (all:"accelerat" OR all:"distill" OR all:"efficien")
queries.why: Deployment: inference cost, sampling acceleration, and distillation of video diffusion.

queries.label: real-time-distillation-deployment
queries.query: all:"distillation" AND all:"diffusion" AND (all:"video" OR all:"latent" OR all:"model")
queries.why: Deployment: one/few-step distillation for practical video generation throughput.

queries.label: robot-video-worldmodel-adjacent
queries.query: all:"video generation" AND all:"robot"
queries.why: Adjacent/embodied: video generation and world models for robotics (links to EA-4D/EA-EVAL).

queries.label: latent-planning-worldmodel-adjacent
queries.query: all:"latent" AND all:"planning" AND all:"world model"
queries.why: Adjacent: planning in the latent space of a video/diffusion world model.

queries.label: video-generation-survey-adjacent
queries.query: all:"video generation" AND all:"survey"
queries.why: Adjacent: surveys mapping the video generation field and its diffusion-transformer core.

browser_fallback_queries.label: dit-video-browser
browser_fallback_queries.why: Web fallback when arXiv under-recovers flagship DiT-video systems.

browser_fallback_queries.label: genie2-worldmodel-browser
browser_fallback_queries.why: Check action-conditioned video world-model systems outside arXiv.

web_calibration_queries.label: dit-video-calibration
web_calibration_queries.query: Diffusion Transformer video generation world model 2025 advances
web_calibration_queries.why: Calibrate current DiT-video terminology and flagship systems.
